# Lab 11.3: Continuous Query → Bigtable / Spanner

## What We Are Going to Do
Continuously export rows into Bigtable so an application can read the latest ride per key with low latency. The same pattern works for Spanner.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a small Bigtable instance and table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud bigtable instances create lab-bt-cq --display-name="CQ lab" --cluster-config=id=c1,zone=us-central1-b,nodes=1
cbt -instance=lab-bt-cq createtable latest_rides &amp;&amp; cbt -instance=lab-bt-cq createfamily latest_rides ride
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=serviceAccount:bq-continuous@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigtable.user --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Start the continuous export.** In continuous query mode with the `bq-continuous` service account (replace `YOUR_PROJECT`):


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">EXPORT DATA
OPTIONS (
  format = 'CLOUD_BIGTABLE',
  uri = 'https://bigtable.googleapis.com/projects/YOUR_PROJECT/instances/lab-bt-cq/appProfiles/default/tables/latest_rides',
  bigtable_options = """{"columnFamilies": [{"familyId": "ride", "columns": [
     {"qualifierString": "fare", "fieldName": "fare"},
     {"qualifierString": "city", "fieldName": "city"}]}]}"""
) AS
SELECT city AS rowkey, STRUCT(fare, city) AS ride
FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The row key is the city, so each city row always holds the latest ride.

3. **[CLI] Generate data and read Bigtable.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">./gen_rides.sh
cbt -instance=lab-bt-cq read latest_rides</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Spanner version.** For Spanner use `format = 'CLOUD_SPANNER'`, `uri = 'https://spanner.googleapis.com/projects/P/instances/I/databases/D'` and `spanner_options = '{"table": "rides"}'`.

5. **[CLI] Cancel the query and delete Bigtable.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud bigtable instances delete lab-bt-cq --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Destination | Bigtable (or Spanner) |
| Row key | `rowkey` column |
| Serving | Apps read the latest value with low latency |
| Clean-up | Cancel the job, delete the instance |
